The Gustave Eiffel project from the 1889 Exposition Universelle is the Eiffel Tower.
Within a 10km radius of the Eiffel Tower, there are 2 named equestrian statues.
'La Renommée montée sur Pégase' is a named equestrian statue within a 10km radius of the Eiffel Tower.
'Mercure monté sur Pégase' is a named equestrian statue within a 10km radius of the Eiffel Tower.
